result.title: Know When the Equation Is Wrong: Structural Uncertainty for LLM-Guided Symbolic Regression under Extrapolation
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can help discover mathematical equations from data, but most LLM-guided symbolic regression methods focus on a single best equation without quantifying uncertainty over alternative functional forms. This is challenging because distinct equations can fit the observed data similarly while producing substantially different extrapolations. Our experiments on the LLM-SRBench dataset show that standard conformal intervals achieve nominal in-distribution coverage but frequently fail under extrapolation. To tackle this challenge, we introduce LLM-SR-UQ, a framework that retains competing equation structures and uses their disagreement to characterize uncertainty about the underlying functional form. We extend the standard fixed-width conformal approach to quantify structural intervals, which measure disagreement among candidate equations and identify where prediction intervals should widen. Extensive experiments show our framework substantially improves coverage attainment by incorporating structural disagreement while preserving in-distribution coverage. Our approach also shows good generalizability when it is applied to other symbolic-regression methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LLM-SR-UQ，在 LLM 引导的符号回归中保留多个候选方程结构，用结构间分歧构造「结构区间」，以改善外推条件下的不确定性覆盖。
AI.relevance_reason: 保留多个竞争假设并以分歧量化不确定性、据此判断何时扩大区间的做法，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的分歧度量与停止/证据筛选决策提供可核查的方法线索，但任务领域与视觉推理相距较远。
